claims.text: The Pasir Lane Hawker Archive documents recipes and oral histories from retiring hawkers.

citations.quote: founded by retired teacher Halimah Rashid

claims.text: The founding is attributed to a collective of nine volunteers with no single founder.

citations.quote: more than 600 recipes, from char kway teow to putu piring

claims.text: Recordings began in a Pasir Ris void deck before moving to a dedicated unit above a wet market.
